name: win-probability
title: NBA win probability
description: An NBA win probability card for json-render chats: one game in one card, each team's logo and name over Fluid's steps Slider filled in its color, the percent on hover, and what a win pays back. ESPN's prediction before tip-off, the live chance during the game, the result after. With its API route in front of ESPN's public scores.
docs:
Turn the card on in the chat (one line in each file, see the comments in them):

  features/chat/chat-catalog.ts:   WinProbabilityCard: winProbabilityCatalogEntry
  features/chat/chat-registry.tsx: WinProbabilityCard: ({ props, loading }) => <LiveWinProbabilityCard team={props.team || undefined} date={props.date} streaming={loading} />
  features/chat/chat-steps.ts:     WinProbabilityCard: winProbabilityLookup

Chances load from /api/win-probability (installed at app/api/win-probability/route.ts), backed by ESPN's public site API; the game is found with the NBA scoreboard's lookup in features/scoreboard/. No API key needed; a game in progress refreshes every 30 seconds.
